## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `tools/bestpractices/`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API, so a person fixes each one, logged in at https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42/passing: correct the answer, or regenerate `.bestpractices.json` (`python3 -I ../.github/tools/bestpractices/bestpractices.py answers . --write`) and press "Save (and continue)" with the robot; a justification pointing at a moved file gets the new URL. A lost level is answered on the site first.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry is clean.

---

## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `tools/bestpractices/`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API, so a person fixes each one, logged in at https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42/passing: correct the answer, or regenerate `.bestpractices.json` (`python3 -I ../.github/tools/bestpractices/bestpractices.py answers . --write`) and press "Save (and continue)" with the robot; a justification pointing at a moved file gets the new URL. A lost level is answered on the site first.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry is clean.

---

## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `tools/bestpractices/`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository ([run](https://github.com/swarm-routing/.github/actions/runs/123)).

## Findings

- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API, so a person fixes each one, logged in at https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42/passing: correct the answer, or regenerate `.bestpractices.json` (`python3 -I ../.github/tools/bestpractices/bestpractices.py answers . --write`) and press "Save (and continue)" with the robot; a justification pointing at a moved file gets the new URL. A lost level is answered on the site first.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry is clean.

## Findings

- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

bestpractices.dev has no write API, so a person fixes each one, logged in at https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42/passing: correct the answer, or regenerate `.bestpractices.json` (`python3 -I ../.github/tools/bestpractices/bestpractices.py answers . --write`) and press "Save (and continue)" with the robot; a justification pointing at a moved file gets the new URL. The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `tools/bestpractices/`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API, so a person fixes each one, logged in at https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42/passing: correct the answer, or regenerate `.bestpractices.json` (`python3 -I ../.github/tools/bestpractices/bestpractices.py answers . --write`) and press "Save (and continue)" with the robot; a justification pointing at a moved file gets the new URL. A lost level is answered on the site first.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry is clean.

## Context

The weekly `bestpractices` check (swarm-routing/.github `tools/bestpractices/`) found `Proto`'s OpenSSF Best Practices entry (https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42) out of step with the repository.

## Findings

- [ ] build: the site says Unmet, .bestpractices.json says Met
- [ ] contribution: the justification points at GONE.md, not on main
- [ ] level lost: passing since 2026-11-10

## Scope

bestpractices.dev has no write API, so a person fixes each one, logged in at https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/42/passing: correct the answer, or regenerate `.bestpractices.json` (`python3 -I ../.github/tools/bestpractices/bestpractices.py answers . --write`) and press "Save (and continue)" with the robot; a justification pointing at a moved file gets the new URL. A lost level is answered on the site first.

This issue is updated in place by the weekly run and closed when the entry is clean.
